items.title: Live: Trump touts 'swift, overwhelming' victories in Iran in national address
items.description: US President Donald Trump is giving a national address on the Iran war. Follow live.

items.title: Iran briefing: Regardless of what Trump says today, keep an eye on Netanyahu
items.description: Israel sends a reminder that this war is broader than Donald Trump. Plus, confusion around an alleged truce offer from Iran's "new president".

items.title: Days of placating Trump are over as Europeans push back
items.description: Early on, world leaders went out of their way to placate Donald Trump. But as the war with Iran drags into a second month, the UK and European leaders are finding their voices.

items.title: US burning through years' worth of critical weapons stockpiles in Iran
items.description: Analysts estimate the US is burning through high-end weapons in Iran at a rate that could take years to replenish, risking the West's military readiness for other potential conflicts.

items.title: Live: 'We have a beautiful moonrise': NASA's Artemis II crew begins its lunar mission
items.description: Four astronauts are on board the Orion capsule atop NASA's next-generation SLS rocket as humanity prepares to return to the Moon for the first time since 1972. Follow live.

items.title: Artemis II astronauts prepare for mission lift-off
items.description: When a mission like Artemis II launches, most of the excitement happens in the first few minutes. What should we be looking out for?

items.title: Breaking: Powerful magnitude-7.4 earthquake strikes Indonesia, tsunami warning issued
items.description: The quake, which hit early Thursday local time, had a depth of 35 kilometres and its epicentre was 127km west-north-west of Ternate, Indonesia, the US Geological Survey said.

items.title: International crypto firm targets uni students despite ASIC ban
items.description: A major cryptocurrency platform is operating like "gambling" in Australia, according to experts, despite new regulatory laws.

items.title: 'Domino effect': Why Singapore's oil shock will play out in Australia
items.description: Singapore is exposed to the oil shock from Iran’s effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz, and its response will shape the fuel crisis in Australia.

items.title: Track the latest petrol and diesel prices around Australia
items.description: See what's happening with petrol and diesel prices near you, updated constantly.

items.title: Albanese will today try to defend his prime-time message
items.description: With no realistic end in sight and a whole lot of economic pain to come, the PM's decision to make a direct plea to the nation was not one taken lightly.

items.title: Live: PM to respond to major report on online gambling
items.description: It has been more than 1,000 days since the government received a report from an inquiry, led by late Labor MP Peta Murphy, into the harm caused by online gambling and gambling advertising.

items.title: Live: ASX opens in the green
items.description: The ASX opens higher following another day of gains on Wall Street. Follow the day's events and insights from our business reporters on the ABC News live markets blog.

items.title: Bondi gunman fails to have family's identities suppressed for 40 years
items.description: Lawyers for Bondi gunman Naveed Akram fail in a bid to have the identities of his mother, brother and sister protected by a decades-long court suppression order on safety grounds.

items.title: How to nurture your non-work identity
items.description: The centrality of work in our lives can't be denied, especially when Australians are working longer hours than ever before. But short of quitting our jobs, how do we shift the balance?

items.title: 'Marshmallow fluff': All-star cast can't save The Super Mario Galaxy Movie
items.description: Even with downgraded expectations, the Nintendo sequel is little more than Easter eggs and bright colours. But that won't stop it from filling cinemas.

items.title: Museum fans: Test yourself with our curious collection of trivia
items.description: Australia’s museums hold a treasure trove of odd facts, native animals and even burlesque history. So how much do you know about the things hidden in our nation’s vaults?

items.title: 'Dance for me': Australian Harrods survivor tells of Mohamed Al Fayed abuse
items.description: Jessica tried to keep her distance from Harrods billionaire owner Mohamed Al Fayed, who was known to abuse his female staff, until he spotted her going down an escalator.

items.title: One Nation candidate published antisemitic, racist and homophobic posts
items.description: A One Nation candidate in the South Australian election was accused of domestic abuse, bullying and harassment, while another made racist, antisemitic and homophobic social media posts, raising fresh questions about the party's vetting processes as it surges in popularity.

items.title: Gas exports face halt as winter shortages loom
items.description: It is the first time the government has taken a step towards using the powers it has to limit exports, and it comes at a time when the profits from those exports appear set to surge.

items.title: Weather to deliver Easter treat, but another cyclone looms next week
items.description: Australia has just been soaked by its third wettest February-March on record, but for most of the country, skies have cleared up just in time for Easter.

items.title: Shark relocation offers temporary safety boost, Queensland study suggests
items.description: A new study analysing the behaviour of tiger sharks relocated from the Great Barrier Reef Marine Park under the Queensland Shark Control Program shows tiger sharks relocated from swimming beaches generally return to a beach within about three months.

items.title: Trial pours cold water on current EV truck viability despite diesel price hike
items.description: A 2.5-year trial of an electric truck in SA's forestry industry has concluded with the truck now parked, finding it was able to do the job but wasn't cost effective, even with high fuel prices.

items.title: Storm forward leaves hospital after suffering suspected stroke
items.description: The club says Tui Kamikamica will now "commence a period of inpatient rehabilitation" after the "medical episode" on Monday.

items.title: DNA links US serial killer Ted Bundy to unsolved 1974 murder
items.description: New DNA testing definitively links infamous serial killer Ted Bundy to the unsolved death of a US teenager in 1974.
